2607.29185.title: Learning Latent Reasoning Traces for Scalar Reward Models End-to-End
2607.29185.paper_summary: Reward models (RMs) are central to aligning large language models with human preferences via reinforcement learning. Although traditional scalar RMs enable efficient and probabilistic reward modeling, they rely on superficial cues that fail to generalize to complex or out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks. Conversely, generative RMs leverage extensive reasoning to improve robustness on challenging tasks, but their natural language-based scores lack the numerical flexibility and probabilistic interpretability that scalar RMs offer. While recent approaches combine both paradigms through off-policy multi-task learning, such parallel optimization does not guarantee that generated reasoning traces actively align with or benefit downstream scalar reward prediction. To address this mismatch, we propose LatentRM, a reward modeling framework that learns intermediate reasoning traces as discrete latent variables to explicitly maximize the likelihood of downstream scalar rewards. Through on-policy optimization of the latent reasoning space end-to-end, LatentRM tightly couples deep reasoning-based evaluation with precise scoring. Extensive validations on in-distribution and OOD datasets and RLHF show that LatentRM outperforms scalar, generative, and hybrid RMs on preference modeling and policy alignment across tasks ranging from open-ended conversation to complex reasoning.
2607.29185.paper_summary_zh: 獎勵模型（RMs）是通過強化學習將大型語言模型與人類偏好對齊的核心。雖然傳統的標量 RMs 能夠實現高效和概率性的獎勵建模，但它們依賴於表面的線索，無法對複雜或分佈外（OOD）任務進行泛化。相反，生成性 RMs 利用廣泛的推理來提高在挑戰性任務上的穩健性，但它們基於自然語言的分數缺乏標量 RMs 所提供的數值靈活性和概率可解釋性。雖然最近的方法通過離線多任務學習結合了這兩種範式，但這種並行優化並不保證生成的推理痕跡能夠有效對齊或惠及下游的標量獎勵預測。為了解決這一不匹配，我們提出了 LatentRM，一種獎勵建模框架，將中間推理痕跡作為離散潛在變量進行學習，以明確最大化下游標量獎勵的可能性。通過對潛在推理空間的端到端政策優化，LatentRM 緊密結合了基於深度推理的評估與精確計分。在分佈內和 OOD 數據集以及 RLHF 上的廣泛驗證顯示，LatentRM 在偏好建模和政策對齊方面超越了標量、生成性和混合 RMs，涵蓋了從開放式對話到複雜推理的任務。
